items.title: Autodesk’s (NASDAQ:ADSK) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates, Full-Year Outlook Slightly Exceeds Expectations
items.summary: 3D design software company Autodesk (NASDAQ:ADSK) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 16.1% year on year to $2.05 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $2.13 billion at the midpoint, 2.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.30 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
